Implementation Plan

Implementation plan: issue "Phase 3 — the pinned promote cycle" (tracking #7745, local id `phase3-pinned-promote-cycle`)

Spec: `docs/plans/pin-promote-cycle-to-candidate-plan.md`, section Phase 3 and steps P3.1–P3.10. Clarification answers Q1–Q10 are already decided. Q3-A and Q4-B matter most here:
- Q3-A: commits merged mid-cycle wait for the next cycle, and `PROMOTE_CYCLE_PIN_ENABLED=false` unfreezes at once and abandons that cycle's promotion.
- Q4-B: pinning is on by default.

Planning ref: `orchestrator/project-7745` @ `588e155e1a39fef9b0f998a72bf9cd15fa4d8a44`. The integration branch matches.

Prerequisites confirmed on this ref:
- Every `.github/workflows/internal-*.yml` references `@promote-candidate` (`grep -L` prints nothing).
- All 13 reusable workflows contain `source=promote_candidate`.
- `scripts/promote_candidate_follow.sh`, `.github/workflows/promote-candidate-follow.yml` and the README rows for `PROMOTE_CYCLE_PIN_ENABLED` / `PROMOTE_CYCLE_FREEZE_MAX_SECS` (README lines 249–250) already exist from phase 2. So P3.9 extends those rows; it adds no new ones.
- `.github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml` is 128,246 bytes, far below the 480,000-byte guard.

Scope-mode: Hold Scope
Reuse-audit: extends promote_main_cycle.sh / comprehensive_promotion_gate_before_final_merge
Scope-mode justification: The issue and the spec list the exact behaviour, file set and new names, so this plan implements that scope and nothing more. Everything extends existing code:
- the guard sequence, `skip_cycle` / `fail_cycle` and the smoke-gate loop in `scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh`;
- the marker-line builder in `scripts/apply_analysis_on_main.sh`;
- `comprehensive_cycle_metadata_json`, `dispatch_comprehensive_verification_run`, `comprehensive_promotion_gate_before_final_merge` and `comprehensive_promotion_hold_or_fail` in `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`.

The only new function is `comprehensive_release_cycle_freeze`, which the issue requires. It follows the existing DELETE pattern (`git/refs/heads/...` at line 12186). Some completeness items are each under 30 lines and add no dependency or interface, so per the Boil-the-Lake rule they are included (§6: correctness ranks above speed):
- the poller-side handling of `PROMOTE_CYCLE_PIN_ENABLED=false` (Q3-A);
- the read-failure hold;
- falling back to unpinned when the freeze fails.

## Automation & wiring (§20.E)
- **New scripts:** none. The change extends `scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh`, `scripts/apply_analysis_on_main.sh` and `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`.
- **Scheduler entry points (already wired):**
  - `.github/workflows/promote-main-to-stable.yml`, job `cycle` (schedule `0 0 * * *`): the freeze, the pinned smoke gate and the proving dispatch.
  - `.github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml`, via `internal-orchestrate-poll.yml` on its `*/5` cron: the pinned verifying dispatch, the pinned promotion gate and tag release.
  - `.github/workflows/promote-candidate-follow.yml` (phase 2): already honours the tag.
- **Long-running supervisor:** none. The cycle is a scheduled job and the poller already exists.
- **DB work:** none.
- **`docs/scripts-pending-removal.md`:** no entry, because no new single-use, long-running or supervisor script is added.

## Functions or modules to implement

### A. `scripts/promote_main_cycle.sh`

The script's numbered comments run 1–7: 1 another_run_active, 2 cycle_in_flight, 3–5 code-change, baseline and failed-attempt guards, 6 insufficient_docs, 7 smoke gate. The issue's "guards 1-6" are the blocks before `# 7. Smoke gate`.

**1. Defaults** (next to the existing `PROMOTE_CYCLE_*` defaults; §8):
- `PROMOTE_CYCLE_PIN_ENABLED="${PROMOTE_CYCLE_PIN_ENABLED:-true}"`
- `PROMOTE_CYCLE_FREEZE_MAX_SECS="${PROMOTE_CYCLE_FREEZE_MAX_SECS:-172800}"`
  - If it is not a positive integer, warn and use 172800, as the follower does.
- Read-only constants: `PROMOTE_CYCLE_PIN_BRANCH=promote-candidate` and `PROMOTE_CYCLE_PIN_TAG=promote-cycle-frozen`. These are script-local constants, not env vars; the grep found no clash.
- Header comment: document both variables and the new log lines.

**2. Pre-flight, P3.1.** Inserted after guard 6, before `# 7. Smoke gate`. It sets `pin_mode=false|true`. The checks, in order:

| Check | If it fails |
|---|---|
| Switch: only the literal `false` (any letter case) disables, matching the follower | `PROMOTE_CYCLE_PIN outcome=skipped reason=disabled` |
| `grep -L '@promote-candidate' .github/workflows/internal-*.yml` (run in `REPO_ROOT`, the job's checkout) must print nothing, and the glob must match at least one file | `reason=wrappers_not_pinned` |
| Each of the 13 named reusable workflows must exist and `grep -q 'source=promote_candidate'` (list kept in one bash array) | `reason=support_not_pinned` |
| `gh api repos/<repo>/branches/promote-candidate`: HTTP 404 (same detection as `resolve_tag_commit`) | `reason=branch_missing` |
| Same call: `.protected != true` | `reason=branch_unprotected` |
| Same call: any other read failure | `reason=branch_lookup_failed` (see D3) |

Every skip line is followed by today's unpinned path.

**3. Freeze, P3.2.** Runs only when `pin_mode=true`. It is placed after the gate idle-wait loop and before `before_gate_ids` / the dispatch (see D2).
- **Stale-tag cleanup.** `GET git/ref/tags/promote-cycle-frozen` (1 call). If the tag exists, guards 1–2 have already shown no other cycle run and no labelled tracking issue, so the tag is stale:
  - log `::warning::` with the tag's age when its annotated `frozen_at` is readable (1 extra `git/tags/<sha>` read, only in this case), compared against `PROMOTE_CYCLE_FREEZE_MAX_SECS`;
  - `DELETE git/refs/tags/promote-cycle-frozen` (404 counts as done);
  - log `PROMOTE_CYCLE_PIN outcome=stale_tag_deleted`.
  - A failed read or delete counts as a failed freeze (below).
- **Create the tag.**
  - `POST git/tags` with `tag=promote-cycle-frozen`, `message="frozen_at=<epoch> cycle_run=${GITHUB_RUN_ID}"`, `object=<main_tip>`, `type=commit`.
  - `POST git/refs` with `ref=refs/tags/promote-cycle-frozen`, `sha=<tag object sha>`. Use one attempt (no retry), because a retried POST is not idempotent.
  - HTTP 422 with "Reference already exists" means a race with another freeze: `skip_cycle cycle_in_flight "tag=promote-cycle-frozen"`, before any trap is set.
- **Set the trap.** Right after the ref is created: `trap pin_release_freeze EXIT`. The new function `pin_release_freeze` sends `DELETE git/refs/tags/promote-cycle-frozen`, ignores 404, warns on any other failure and never changes the exit code.
- **Fast-forward the branch.** `PATCH git/refs/heads/promote-candidate` with `sha=<main_tip>`, `force=false`.
  - If the PATCH is rejected as not a fast-forward, read the branch tip. If `compare/<main_tip>...<branch_tip>` shows status `ahead` (the follower already moved it past `main_tip`), reconcile:
    - create a new tag object at the branch tip;
    - `PATCH git/refs/tags/promote-cycle-frozen` with the new object sha and `force=true` (tag ref only, see D4);
    - candidate = branch tip;
    - log `PROMOTE_CYCLE_PIN outcome=candidate_advanced main_tip=<sha> candidate=<sha>`.
  - Otherwise the PATCH succeeded and candidate = `main_tip`.
- **Freeze failures.** Any other failure (tag create with a status other than 422, PATCH error, compare not `ahead`, reconcile error):
  - delete the tag if it was created and clear the trap;
  - log `PROMOTE_CYCLE_PIN outcome=skipped reason=freeze_failed detail=<step>`;
  - set `pin_mode=false` and continue unpinned (see D3).
- On success, log `PROMOTE_CYCLE_PIN outcome=frozen candidate=<sha>`. `pin_candidate_sha` holds the candidate.

**4. Smoke gate, P3.3.**
- Dispatch `--ref` is `promote-candidate` when pinned and `${PROMOTE_CYCLE_DEFAULT_BRANCH}` otherwise.
- The jq `--arg branch` in the run-matching filter uses the same value. The `display_title` filter is unchanged.
- The echo line names the ref.
- After the gate passes (cancelled stays `skip_cycle`, failures stay `fail_cycle`; the trap deletes the tag on each), when pinned:
  - require `gate_head_sha` to match `^[0-9a-f]{40}$` and equal `pin_candidate_sha`, otherwise `fail_cycle pin_head_mismatch "gate_head=<sha|none> candidate=<sha>"`;
  - set `smoke_sha=${pin_candidate_sha}`;
  - skip both the "main advanced" warning and the `smoke_sha != main_tip` checkout block (the issue says to skip it; see Risks).
- The unpinned branch keeps today's exact lines.

**5. Proving dispatch, P3.4.** When pinned:
- the dispatcher env adds `APPLY_ANALYSIS_PINNED=true`;
- `APPLY_ANALYSIS_CYCLE_BASELINE_SHA` and `APPLY_ANALYSIS_SMOKE_SHA` are both the candidate;
- `GITHUB_SHA` is the candidate.

When unpinned the dispatcher gets `APPLY_ANALYSIS_PINNED=false` and the existing values.

`skip_cycle dispatcher:*` still fires the trap. Right after the `PROMOTE_CYCLE_DISPATCHED` echo, run `trap - EXIT`. That line also gains ` pinned=<true|false>`, appended at the end, so existing parsers keep working.

New output `emit_output pinned <true|false>` and `emit_output candidate_sha <sha>`, both additive.

### B. `scripts/apply_analysis_on_main.sh` (P3.5)
- Default: `APPLY_ANALYSIS_PINNED="${APPLY_ANALYSIS_PINNED:-false}"`, documented in the header env list.
- Only the literal `true` (lower-cased compare) counts. Any value other than `true`/`false` warns and counts as false.
- When true:
  - append `marker_lines+=$'\n'"apply-analysis-pinned: true"` after the proving-merge line;
  - the verifying `role_prose` says the poller pro
